name: Opal
author: Derek Ross
description: Nostr in your Omarchy bar: a NIP-46 signer (bunker) that keeps your nsec in the keyring, notifications (replies, mentions, zaps, DMs), and NIP-38 now-playing and status. Needs the opald daemon: run dist/install.sh.

barWidget.description: Your Nostr keys, the apps allowed to use them, notifications and status.
